name: ${KNOWLEDGE_BASE_NAME}
description: FoundryIQ knowledge base for Queensland Government and business.gov.au grants and assistance, including programs available in Queensland and other jurisdictions.
retrievalInstructions: Use the grants knowledge source for questions about grants, funding, rebates, concessions, loans or assistance programs. Prefer currently open programs available in Queensland unless the user explicitly requests another jurisdiction or past programs. Check each record's jurisdictions and source; business.gov.au listings are not necessarily federally administered.
answerInstructions: Answer concisely. For each grant mention its title, whether it is open, the closing date and amount when known, and cite the source ref_id. If nothing relevant is found, say so.
